insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for unfulfilled orders. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and applies to API version 2026-10 and later. The recalculation occurs against the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating orders through the GraphQL Admin API. They should test their apps to ensure they handle the tax recalculation correctly. This change may require updates to their code, especially if they are using the orderUpdate mutation. The GraphQL Admin API will return the updated taxes in the order response.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations for their orders, even when the shipping address is updated. This change improves the overall accuracy of order totals and tax amounts.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures that merchants and customers see the correct order totals. It also brings the GraphQL Admin API in line with other Shopify APIs that recalculate taxes when the shipping address is updated.

Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and customizable cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed, improving inventory management.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing for easier deployment of Hydrogen storefronts.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, improving order management.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, making it easier for apps to achieve the Built for Shopify badge.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 has removed deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, improving trust and confidence in collaborator access.

recap.headline: Shopify updates bring new data and features for developers

themes.title: New Data Availability
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. Additionally, standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, enabling more flexible cart management.

themes.title: Development Tools Updates
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. This update aims to improve the development experience for Shopify developers.
